title: 09. Production & Safety: Semantic Cache
summary: Cache LLM responses so that similar questions get the cached answer instead of calling the LLM again. Not just exact matches — semantically similar queries hit the cache too.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Cache LLM responses so that **similar questions** get the cached answer instead of calling the LLM again. Not just exact matches — **semantically similar** queries hit the cache too.

sections.title: Semantic Cache Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              SEMANTIC CACHE — HOW IT WORKS                      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  EXACT MATCH CACHE (naive):          SEMANTIC CACHE (smart):
  ──────────────────────────          ────────────────────────────
  "What is Python?"                   "What is Python?"
  → stored: "Python is..."            → stored: "Python is..."

  "What is Python?" (exact)           "Tell me about Python"
  → CACHE HIT ✅                      → embed → similarity=0.94
                                      → CACHE HIT ✅

  "Tell me about Python"              "Explain Python language"
  → CACHE MISS ❌ (different string)  → embed → similarity=0.91
  → Calls LLM → $0.01                → CACHE HIT ✅

  Semantic cache understands MEANING, not just text!

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CACHE HIT RATE IMPACT (typical production system):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Without cache:   1000 queries → 1000 LLM calls → $50/day
  With cache:      1000 queries → ~300 LLM calls → $15/day
                   Cache hit rate: 70%
                   Savings: $35/day = $1,050/month

  Also benefits:
  • Latency:  Cache hit = 5ms vs 1500ms (300x faster!)
  • Rate limits: 70% fewer API calls
  • Consistency: Same questions get same answers

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CACHE ARCHITECTURE:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Query comes in:
       │
       ▼
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  1. Embed the query → vector [0.3, 0.7, ...]            │
  │  2. Search cache for similar vectors                    │
  │  3. Found similar entry? (similarity > threshold)       │
  │     YES → return cached response (5ms) ✅               │
  │     NO  → call LLM (1500ms) → store in cache → return  │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  TTL (Time to Live) per content type:
  ┌────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
  │  Content Type          │  Cache Duration              │
  ├────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
  │  Static facts          │  24 hours                    │
  │  Technical docs        │  6 hours                     │
  │  News/current events   │  15 minutes                  │
  │  Stock prices/weather  │  1-5 minutes                 │
  │  User-specific data    │  DO NOT CACHE (privacy!)     │
  └────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘
```
